text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr admires the Umamusume
known 
as the "Emperor of the Mile." Her goal is 
to become a wind that is strong, free,
and faster than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Driven by her strong pursuit of ideals, 
Yamanin Zephyr grew anxious about a lack 
of training once her debut was set, and 
ended up overworking herself in practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She once lost her chance due to an
injury. 
Her Trainer wants to guide her well to 
prevent that from happening again and 
grant her wish to become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There,
the Trainer promised to "become the 
wind at her back." With renewed trust in 
the Trainer,
Yamanin Zephyr wrapped up the 
day's training.
